comparison.objective: Seat and trim a wire on a 110 block versus tune an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient a punch-down tool, align wire/contact, and apply a terminating stroke versus engage a recessed setscrew, rotate a collar, relock, and cycle-test.
comparison.success_condition: Correct conductor seated and loose end trimmed without cutting the run versus two acceptable carriage stops and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both use oriented tools and bounded force, but the functional operations and success evidence differ. Candidate locking and dynamic limits are only partly declared.
